annonces.titre: Rolex Cosmograph Daytona - Réf.116509 - Or blanc 18k - 2008
annonces.description:
Launched in 2000,
reference 116509 marked a pivotal moment in the history of the Cosmograph
Daytona, as it introduced for the first time the in-house Rolex calibre
4130—developed internally after over a decade of research. Presented here in a
precious 18-carat white gold configuration, this 2008 version perfectly blends
the power of a racing chronograph with the refined elegance of noble metals.
Encircling the dial,
the fixed bezel features a tachymetric scale engraved directly into the white
gold. A hallmark of the Daytona since its inception, this function enables the
calculation of average speed over a given distance. With markings up to 400 units
per hour, it serves as a true performance instrument, directly inspired by the
world of motorsport.
The dial of this
model is one of its most striking and sought-after elements. Its deep black
background is accented with vivid red details—railroad-style minute track,
subdial surrounds, and central chronograph hand. These sporty touches recall
the dashboard instruments of vintage race cars. Applied Arabic numerals in
white gold and partially skeletonized baton hands are filled with luminous
material, ensuring optimal legibility in low-light conditions. This
configuration, nicknamed the “racing dial” by collectors, is relatively rare
for this reference.
Reference 116509
houses the Rolex calibre 4130, an automatic chronograph movement developed
entirely in-house. Equipped with a vertical clutch and column whee

annonces.titre: Rolex Milgauss 1019 - full set - 1973
annonces.description:
Antimagnetic Chronometer – Original Box & Papers
The Rolex Milgauss,
introduced in the 1950s, was created at a time when science, industry, and
technology began placing new demands on mechanical watches. The reference 1019,
launched in the late 1960s and produced until 1988, represents the most refined
evolution of this now-legendary timepiece.
It was specifically
engineered to meet the needs of scientists at CERN (European Organization for
Nuclear Research). Thanks to an internal Faraday cage, it withstands magnetic
fields of up to 1,000 gauss—where traditional watches would lose all precision.
This version
features a vertically brushed silver dial, minimalist and highly legible, with
black hands accented in red and a slim red-tipped seconds hand. Its smooth
bezel and robust Oyster bracelet enhance its technical and professional
character.
This rare 1973
example is in exceptional condition and comes complete with original box,
papers, chronometer certificate, and Milgauss brochure—a truly unique
opportunity on today’s market.
1-year in-house warranty on proper functioning

annonces.titre: Montre d'occasion - Rolex Datejust 16030 - N°2307C
annonces.description:
Cette Rolex Datejust réf. 16030 de 1983 se distingue par son élégant cadran champagne et son emblématique bracelet Jubilee, qui lui confèrent une allure à la fois classique et raffinée. 
 Avec son boîtier de 36 mm et son mouvement automatique, elle incarne parfaitement l’équilibre propre à la Datejust : une montre polyvalente, élégante et facile à porter au quotidien. 
 Son cadran champagne apporte une tonalité chaleureuse et typiquement vintage, tandis que le bracelet Jubilee renforce le caractère iconique de ce modèle. 
 Une pièce intemporelle, représentative du style Rolex des années 1980.

annonces.titre: Rolex Daytona White Gold Beach Blue Dial
annonces.description:
Rolex Daytona 116519 is a 2008 chronograph with a 40mm white gold case and a pale blue Beach dial. Three subdials sit on the face: a 30-minute counter on the right, a 12-hour counter on the left and running seconds at the bottom. Black print names Rolex, Oyster Perpetual, Superlative Chronometer Officially Certified and Cosmograph, and the word Daytona is printed in red. The hands are black with white-filled centers.
 The white gold bezel carries an engraved tachymeter scale, and the crown and chronograph pushers have a ribbed grip. Instead of a metal bracelet, the watch comes on a light blue leather strap with a textured scale pattern and stitched edges. The movement is automatic, so the rotor winds it as you move. This Rolex Daytona is available in very good condition.

annonces.titre: Rolex Datejust 41 Two Tone Sundust Diamond dial
annonces.description:
This is the Rolex Datejust 41mm in brand-new condition. The watch features a Sundust Dial, adorned with Diamond-set hour markers. It flaunts a stainless steel case along with a Rose Gold Smooth/Domed Bezel. Offering both comfort and style, the watch is further complimented with a Two-Tone Oyster Bracelet, which is built from a fusion of Stainless Steel and Rose Gold.  Acquired in 2023, this brand-new Rolex Datejust 41mm arrives with its original boxes and papers
 For those seeking a watch that transcends trends and embodies sophistication, the Rolex Datejust 41mm stands as one of the best options in this price bracket. The watch even comes with the Superlative Chronometer certification ensuring great timekeeping. With this, Rolex also promises a precision of -2/+2 sec/day.

annonces.titre: Rolex Datejust 31 Steel with Blue Roman Dial & Jubilee Bracelet
annonces.description:
Presenting the Rolex Datejust 31mm flaunting a mesmerizing Blue Dial with Roman Numerals on it. It is a brand-new watch with a 2024 purchase date, which makes it highly sought after. Being a Datejust model, this one gets a date window at 3 o’clock ensuring both functionality and refinement. Encased in stainless steel, the 31mm watch is paired with a White Gold Fluted Bezel. The striking Jubilee Bracelet, perfectly balances the look and appeal of the watch and sits very comfortably on the wrist. It is a very subtle yet unique combination.
 Rolex Datejust 31mm reference 278273 is available in a variety of dial color options. The 31mm Datejust lineup is specially designed for women and it is not just available in stainless steel but also comes in two-tone options and in full gold variants.

annonces.titre: Rolex GMT-Master II Pavé Dial with Sapphire & Ruby Bezel
annonces.description:
The Rolex GMT Master II 126755SARU is a rare jewel, an off-catalogue creation from Rolex that defies convention. Featuring a Pavé Dial, this timepiece comes with a factory-set Sapphire and Ruby bezel, giving it the bi-color look the GMT Master series is known for. Besides that, the watch even gets Diamonds gracefully embellished on the lugs and on the crown guards. All of this is set on a 18ct Rose Gold case, which sits on a 18ct Rose Gold bracelet. Overall, these diamonds and precious stones create a mesmerizing look. This is one of the most sought-after watches Rolex has ever introduced.
 This one in particular does not come with box and papers. However, that means that you can get this rare timepiece on your wrist for a relatively lower price than what you would have had to pay if it did had the box and papers. Reach out to us for a price request and discover the allure of owning a truly rare and off-catalogue gem from Rolex.

annonces.titre: Rolex Oyster Perpetual 36 with Tiffany Dial
annonces.description:
The Rolex Oyster Perpetual 36 ref. 126000 with the turquoise “Tiffany” dial has become one of the most recognizable modern OPs. It offers a clean and minimal design, which is appealing to many. The 36mm Oystersteel case and Oyster bracelet keep the watch understated, but the vibrant dial makes it pop instantly. No date, no complications, just the purest form of Rolex design with a playful twist. Purchased in 2024, this example comes pre-owned with box and papers. Offered in a great condition, this piece still has the Rolex warranty intact.
 Inside, the Calibre 3230 delivers Rolex’s latest-generation performance, with a 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer accuracy. For collectors looking to add one of the most talked-about dial variations of recent years, this Oyster Perpetual “Tiffany” remains a standout choice.

annonces.titre: Rolex Submariner Hulk with Green Dial & Green Ceramic Bezel
annonces.description:
Get this Rolex Submariner Hulk in like-new condition. It comes complete with its original box and papers. The watch features a 40mm case, which is made from stainless steel and paired with a beautifully matched steel bracelet. And the green Cerachrom bezel insert made of ceramic is what makes this model more defining and beautiful. The green Cerachrom bezel also matches the green dial. Likewise, the dial uses luminous shapes for markers instead of numerals. Purchased in 2019, this watch gets a 1-year warranty from WatchMaestro.
 When you put this Submariner Hulk on your wrist, it feels beautiful, comfortable, and reliable. Not only does the 40mm size fit well on most men’s wrists, but it also does not feel too large or heavy. The steel bracelet is smooth and cozy and does not pull hair. Thus, this luxury watch is comfortable for all-day wear. The green color looks very unique, especially under bright sunlight. The dial feels awesome and vivid in sunlight, while it appears more subtle indoors. So, this Submariner Hulk will surely add a unique color to your outfit.

annonces.titre: Rolex Sea-Dweller 44mm James Cameron
annonces.description:
The Rolex Sea-Dweller James Cameron, reference 136650, is an excellent dive watch built for extreme depths. The 2025 model is completely unworn and includes its original box and papers. It uses a large 44mm steel case that feels very solid. The most unique feature is the dial because it starts bright blue at the top and slowly turns black at the bottom, just like the deep ocean. A solid ceramic bezel surrounds the glass to prevent everyday scratches.  
 The Sea-Dweller has a very accurate automatic movement, which keeps exact time without a battery. The thick steel bracelet matches the heavy case and balances the watch comfortably on your wrist. The dial has no standard numbers. That’s why the large glowing markers make reading the time very easy in dark places. It is a highly reliable steel watch for men who want true quality and excellent water resistance.

annonces.description: The pre-owned Rolex Oyster Perpetual 31mm in steel with the “Tiffany” turquoise blue dial (Ref. 277200) is a highly sought-after timepiece. Known for its vibrant and eye-catching turquoise blue dial, this watch combines Rolex’s signature elegance with a modern, playful touch. The 31mm Oyster case is crafted from durable stainless steel, paired with a matching Oyster bracelet. It features Rolex’s precision automatic movement, scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, and 100m water resistance. The “Tiffany” blue dial has become iconic, making this model a standout choice for collectors and enthusiasts.
